precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3-minus-Q2 total net revenue is +86 USD million; net financing revenue +68 and other revenue +18 exactly reconcile that change. This accounting decomposition does not prove customer or rate drivers.

Q3-minus-Q2 pre-tax income is +77 USD million. The selected GAAP table reconciles it: revenue +86, provision expense +31, noninterest expense -22; +86-31-(-22)=+77. A higher provision offsets part of revenue growth.
Common net income rises +47 USD million and GAAP EPS rises +0.14 USD/share; neither can be fully attributed to the pre-tax bridge without tax, discontinued-operation, and share-count details.
The Q3 exhibit's eight Q2 comparator cells must match the Q2 release current-quarter cells. Compare only the same GAAP row/basis, and do not substitute adjusted/core non-GAAP measures.
Two adjacent quarters do not prove a durable trend, economic value, or a trading conclusion.
